data.name: Enter the Nemesis: Blood Portal
data.detailed_description:
Be prepared to hack, slash, shoot, and torch your way through these bloody levels of platforms. You will be creating part of the platforms yourself by killing your enemies - when an enemy is killed his dead body becomes a platform you can move on. You have to kill enough enemies in order to reveal the hidden blood portals, and pile up the dead bodies of the enemies in order to reach the portal and exit the level and enter the next one. Ultimate goal is to go through all the levels and portals to find your abducted step sister, and try to finish the Nemesis. This game is a bloody action platform adventure.

data.short_description: In this 2.5D hack and slash shooter platformer enemy bodies will become your platform. Kill enemies to activate the portals, and build a platform of bodies to reach the exits. Stomp the bodies, crack skulls, collect blood, and snatch their weapons. Find and free the girl, then defeat the nemesis
